tone: dark satire, unreliable-narrator testimony, injustice and manufactured truth

style_guide.art_style: Korean ink wash painting (sumukhwa) on textured hanji paper, loose expressive brushwork with occasional minhwa folk-art flatness, storybook illustration
style_guide.color_palette: muted sepia and warm paper beige base, deep indigo and charcoal-black ink for figures and shadow, one single crimson-red accent per image used only for danger, injustice, or the rabbit's wound
style_guide.lighting: low harsh directional light casting long hard shadows, overcast desaturated daylight, heavy contrast between lit paper and pooled black ink
style_guide.composition_rule: rule of thirds with generous empty hanji negative space at the top or one side for Korean text overlay; the rabbit rendered small and off-center to emphasize powerlessness, the tortoises rendered large and close to the frame edge
style_guide.texture: visible fibrous handmade paper grain, dry-brush streaks, ink bleed at edges, faint water stains
style_guide.style_suffix: Korean ink wash painting on textured hanji paper, muted sepia and indigo palette with stark charcoal brushstrokes and a single crimson accent, dry-brush texture and ink bleed, harsh directional light with long shadows, generous negative space for text, children's storybook illustration, no text, no letters, no watermark

character_signatures.토끼: a thin frail white rabbit with long drooping ears, narrow shoulders and wide anxious eyes, drawn in fine trembling ink lines
character_signatures.두목 거북이: an enormous muscular green tortoise gang boss with a massive cracked dark shell, thick scarred neck and a smug heavy-lidded stare
character_signatures.부하 거북이 무리: a pack of smaller green tortoises with matching cracked shells, hunched postures and identical blank grinning faces
character_signatures.마을 동물들: timid village animals, a frail thin fox and a scrawny small tiger, watching from a distance with lowered heads

consistency_rules: Every prompt ends with the exact style_suffix string.
Every prompt containing a character embeds that character's signature verbatim.
Exactly one crimson-red accent per image; everything else stays sepia/indigo/charcoal.
Violence is implied through silhouette, shadow and aftermath only - never graphic, never blood.
Rabbit is always drawn smaller in frame than any tortoise present.
Every prompt showing the hilltop turning-point tree or the tortoise boss's memoir embeds that object signature verbatim, so the same tree and the same book appear in every scene.
forbidden: text, letters, hangul, or watermarks inside the image
